slants.name: Praise the mayor
slants.text: Pay the printer to sing the mayor's praises. Approval rises, but less each issue in a row, and a run of flattery can be found out.
slants.lead: A steady hand at the helm: townsfolk agree the mayor has never served them better

slants.name: Cry up a hero
slants.text: Put a hero on the front page. Their fame grows and they warm to you; heroes who prize courage like it.

slants.name: Name the guilds
slants.text: Print what the watch suspects about the town's secret societies. The most active of them comes under scrutiny and may be named outright.
slants.lead: Who meets in our cellars at night? The Crier asks the questions others won't
